items.title: Stained-Glass Tree Branch DXF Panel for Laser-Cut Gates
items.description: Twisting branches spread across the full panel height, their negative space filled with layered leaf shapes in a stained-glass mosaic style. The organic, asymmetrical branch structure gives each half of the double panel a natural, hand-drawn feel rather than a mirrored geometric pattern.
